blocks.text: OOP ke bunyadi tasawwurat programs ko munazzam, dobara qabil-e-istemal aur sambhalne mein asan banate hain: classes aur objects, encapsulation, inheritance aur polymorphism.
Classes aur objects: haqeeqi cheezon ki numaindagi

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Class naqshe (blueprint) ki tarah hai, jab ke object us naqshe se bani asal cheez hai.

Class aik naqsha ya saancha hai jo kisi cheez ki sifaat (attributes) aur kaam (methods) tay karta hai. Object class ka instance hai jis ke attributes ki asal qeematein hoti hain (Fig 3.1). Classes aur objects programmers ko haqeeqi cheezon ka model banane aur data aur us se mutalliq functions ko ikattha rakhne dete hain, jis se programs zyada munazzam hote hain.

blocks.alt: Class aur object ka khaaka: Class: Person ke dabbe mein Attributes (name, age, gender) aur Methods (eat(), sleep(), work()) likhe hain, saath insaan ka saaya. Teer Object P1 (name = Bob, age = 34, gender = Male) aur Object P2 (name = Jenny, age = 27, gender = Female) tak jate hain; dono mein wohi teen methods hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.1: Class aur Object ka rishta (kitab ki Figure 3.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Misal: Student class (Python code; har .... ek 4-space indent hai)
blocks.text:
class Student:
....def __init__(self, name):
........self.name = name

....def display(self):
........print("Student Name:", self.name)

# Creating objects
object1 = Student("Ali")
object2 = Student("Ahmed")

# Using objects
object1.display()
object2.display()

items: class Student talaba ka naqsha tay karti hai.
__init__ constructor hai: object bante hi khud chalta aur naam set karta hai.
self.name har talib-e-ilm ka naam rakhta hai; self khud object ki taraf ishara hai.
display() talib-e-ilm ka naam print karta hai.
object1 aur object2 do alag Student objects hain, har aik ka apna data (Ali, Ahmed); output pehle 'Student Name: Ali' phir 'Student Name: Ahmed' hai.

blocks.text: Encapsulation

blocks.title: Encapsulation
blocks.text: Encapsulation ka matlab data (variables) aur methods (functions) ko aik ikai, yani class, mein band karna aur data tak seedhi rasai mehdood karna hai.

Java ya C++ ke baraks Python mein 'private' ya 'protected' ke sakht keywords nahi; yeh naam rakhne ke riwaj (conventions) se batata hai ke data tak kaise pohanchna chahiye. Encapsulation data ko na-pasandeeda rasai se bachati, security behtar karti, code sambhalna asan banati aur sirf qaboo shuda tabdeeli ki ijazat deti hai. Bank account ka socheein: aap ka balance chhupa hai, aap us tak sirf deposit() aur withdraw() se pohanch sakte hain, aur use seedha nahi badal sakte.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Data chhupayein aur methods se rasai control karein.

blocks.caption: Python mein rasai ke darje
rows: Har jagah se, class ke andar ya bahar, qabil-e-rasai; default mein sab members public
Class aur us ki subclasses ke andar istemal ke liye; riwaj hai, pabandi nahi
Bahar se pohanchna mushkil: Python ki name mangling andar ka naam badal kar ittifaqi rasai rokti

blocks.alt: Encapsulation ka khaaka: User / Outside Class se sabz teer (tick, Access allowed) Class Object ke andar Public Methods / Interface (getValue(), setValue()) tak jata hai; methods se nuqta-daar teer Private Data (__private_variable) tak. User se private data tak laal tooti lakeer par cross aur Direct access restricted likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.2: Private aur public variables dikhane wala encapsulation khaaka (kitab ki Figure 3.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 3.2 mein Private Data ke andar '_private_variable' aik underscore ke saath chhapa hai. Python mein aik underscore (_name) protected ka riwaj hai; private member do underscores (__name) se banta hai, jaise kitab ki table bhi batati hai. Is liye yahan '__private_variable' likha gaya hai. Bahar wala code sirf public methods (getValue(), setValue()) se data tak pohanchta hai; seedhi rasai (direct access) band hai.

blocks.title: Misal: BankAccount mein encapsulation (Python code; har .... ek 4-space indent hai)
blocks.text:
class BankAccount:
....def __init__(self, balance):
........self.__balance = balance      # private variable

....def deposit(self, amount):
........self.__balance += amount

....def withdraw(self, amount):
........if amount <= self.__balance:
............self.__balance -= amount
........else:
............print("Insufficient balance")

....def get_balance(self):
........return self.__balance

# Usage
account = BankAccount(1000)
account.deposit(500)
account.withdraw(300)
print(account.get_balance())      # Output: 1200

# Direct access will fail
# print(account.__balance)        # Error

Balance 1000 se shuru hota hai; 500 jama karne se 1500, aur 300 nikalne se 1200 rehta hai. Bahar se account.__balance parhne ki koshish AttributeError deti hai, kyunke name mangling ne class ke andar variable ka naam badal diya hai.
Inheritance: functionality ka dobara istemal aur wusat

Inheritance aik class ko doosri class ki sifaat aur methods lene deti hai. Nayi class, jise subclass ya child class kehte hain, parent class (superclass) ki khusoosiyat mein izafa ya tabdeeli kar sakti hai. Inheritance code ke dobara istemal ko barhati, takrar kam karti aur maujooda code dobara likhe baghair program ko wasee karna asan banati hai. Child class parent ka naam qausain mein likh kar banti hai: class Child(Parent):.

items: Single inheritance: child class bilkul aik parent class se inherit karti hai (Fig 3.3). Yeh sab se bunyadi shakal hai.

blocks.alt: Single inheritance: Child Class ka dabba Parent Class ke neeche hai; dono aik lakeer se jure hain jis ka khokhla (hollow) teer ka sira Parent Class par hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.3: Single Inheritance (kitab ki Figure 3.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teer child class se parent class ki taraf jata hai aur us ka khokhla (hollow) sira parent par hai. Matlab: child parent se inherit karti hai, yani parent ke attributes aur methods le leti hai. Neeche wali misal mein Animal parent hai aur Dog child.

blocks.title: Misal: single inheritance (Python code; har .... ek 4-space indent hai)
blocks.text:
# Parent class (superclass)
class Animal:
....def __init__(self, name):
........self.name = name

....def eat(self):
........print(f"{self.name} is eating.")

# Child class (subclass) inheriting from Animal
class Dog(Animal):
....def bark(self):
........print(f"{self.name} says Woof!")

my_dog = Dog("Buddy")
my_dog.eat()     # Output: Buddy is eating.
my_dog.bark()    # Output: Buddy says Woof!

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: self maujooda object ka hawala hai; Python ise instance methods ko khud bhejta hai.

items: Parent class (base class): woh class jis ki sifaat inherit hoti hain; oopar Animal.
Child class (derived class): inherit karne wali class; oopar Dog.
Method overriding: child class parent ke maujooda method ka apna version de sakti hai. Us ke andar super() parent ka version call karta hai.

blocks.title: Izafi misal: super() ke saath overriding (Python code; har .... ek 4-space indent hai)
blocks.text:
class Puppy(Dog):
....def eat(self):
........super().eat()                     # parent's version first
........print(f"{self.name} wants more milk.")

Puppy("Moti").eat()
# Output: Moti is eating.
#         Moti wants more milk.

items: Multiple inheritance: child class aik se zyada parent classes se inherit kar ke un ka rawaiya milati hai, maslan Smartphone class jo Camera aur Computer dono se inherit kare (Fig 3.4).

blocks.alt: Multiple inheritance: Child Class ke oopar do dabbe, Parent Class 1 aur Parent Class 2; child se dono parents tak lakeerein, har aik ke sire par parent ki taraf khokhla teer.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.4: Multiple Inheritance (kitab ki Figure 3.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Misal: multiple inheritance (Python code; har .... ek 4-space indent hai)
blocks.text:
class Father:
....def skill1(self):
........print("Father's skill: Gardening")

class Mother:
....def skill2(self):
........print("Mother's skill: Cooking")

# Derived class inheriting from two base classes
class Child(Father, Mother):
....def own_skill(self):
........print("Child's skill: Coding")

c = Child()
c.skill1()      # Father's method
c.skill2()      # Mother's method
c.own_skill()   # its own method

items: Multilevel inheritance: class aisi class se inherit karti hai jo khud derived hai, khandani shajre ki tarah zanjeer (dada, walid, beta); 'pota' class apne parent aur grandparent dono ke methods aur attributes leti hai (Fig 3.5).

blocks.alt: Multilevel inheritance: teen dabbe aik column mein: oopar Grand Parent Class, beech mein Parent Class, neeche Child Class; har neeche wali class oopar wali se khokhle teer wali lakeer se juri hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.5: Multilevel Inheritance (kitab ki Figure 3.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Misal: multilevel inheritance (Python code; har .... ek 4-space indent hai)
blocks.text:
# Base class (grandparent)
class Vehicle:
....def start_engine(self):
........print("Engine started.")

# Intermediate class (parent)
class Car(Vehicle):
....def drive(self):
........print("Car is driving.")

# Derived class (child)
class ElectricCar(Car):
....def charge(self):
........print("Battery is charging.")

my_tesla = ElectricCar()
my_tesla.start_engine()   # inherited from Vehicle
my_tesla.drive()          # inherited from Car
my_tesla.charge()         # defined in ElectricCar

blocks.title: Class activity
blocks.text: Vehicle class banayein aur use Car aur Bike subclasses se wasee karein. Har subclass mein munfarid method dalein aur inheritance dikhayein.
Polymorphism

Polymorphism ka matlab 'kai shaklein' hai. Aik hi method, function ya operator us object ke mutabiq mukhtalif bartao kar sakta hai jis par woh kaam kare, jis se code zyada lachakdar aur dobara qabil-e-istemal hota hai. Maslan payment system credit card, UPI (fauri bank transfer service; Pakistan mein is jaisi Raast hai), net banking aur wallet payments de sakta hai. Sab aik mushtarka method processPayment() use karte hain, lekin har aik ka apna amal hai; maslan net banking user ko bank ke login page par le jati hai. Method ka naam wahi rehta hai jab ke amal payment ki qism ke saath badalta hai.

blocks.title: Izafi misal: aik method ka naam, mukhtalif payment amal (Python code; har .... ek 4-space indent hai)

blocks.text: Polymorphism ki do bari qismein hain, compile-time aur runtime (Fig 3.6).

blocks.alt: Polymorphism ka shajra: Polymorphism se do shakhein: Compile-time Polymorphism jo Method Overloading tak jati hai, aur Runtime Polymorphism jo Method Overriding tak jati hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.6: Aik hi function ka mukhtalif bartao, polymorphism ki misal (kitab ki Figure 3.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Compile-time polymorphism: chalne wala method compilation ke dauran chuna jata hai, aam taur par method ya operator overloading se, jaise Java ya C++ mein. Python function signature ke lihaz se asal overloading nahi deta: dynamically typed hone ki wajah se aik function mukhtalif qism ke arguments le sakta hai. Milta julta bartao default arguments, variable-length arguments (*args, **kwargs) ya function ke andar shartein laga kar hasil hota hai.

Runtime polymorphism (overriding): bartao program chalte waqt method call karne wale object ke mutabiq tay hota hai. Yeh method overriding se hota hai, jab child class parent mein pehle se maujood method ka apna version deti hai.

blocks.title: Misal: default aur variable-length arguments se overloading ki naqal (Python code; har .... ek 4-space indent hai)
blocks.text:
class Calculator:
....def multiply(self, a=1, b=1, *args):
........result = a * b
........for num in args:
............result *= num
........return result

calc = Calculator()
print(calc.multiply())          # 1   (default arguments)
print(calc.multiply(4))         # 4
print(calc.multiply(2, 3))      # 6   (more arguments)
print(calc.multiply(2, 3, 4))   # 24

blocks.title: Misal: overriding se runtime polymorphism (Python code; har .... ek 4-space indent hai)

blocks.text: Aik hi call, animal.sound(), Dog, Cat ya saade Animal ke liye mukhtalif nateeja deti hai, aur yeh intikhab runtime par hota hai. Yeh dynamic bartao Python ko runtime polymorphism ke liye bohat munasib banata hai.

blocks.prompt: Python class mein __init__ ka maqsad kya hai?
blocks.explanation: __init__ constructor hai. Yeh object bante hi khud chalta aur object ke ibtidai attributes, jaise self.name = name, set karta hai.

blocks.prompt: BankAccount class mein agar balance 1200 ho aur program account.withdraw(2000) call kare to kya hoga? Yeh encapsulation ki misal kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh 'Insufficient balance' print karega aur balance 1200 rahega. Private balance sirf un methods se badalta hai jo request jaanchte hain, is liye ghalat tabdeeli ruk jati hai.

blocks.prompt: Inheritance, encapsulation aur polymorphism mil kar behtar software design kaise dete hain?
blocks.explanation: Encapsulation har class ka data mehfooz aur interface wazeh rakhti hai; inheritance code copy karne ke bajaye jaanchi parkhi classes dobara use aur wasee karti hai; polymorphism aik code ko bohat si mutalliq classes ke saath chalne deti hai. Nateeja modular code hai jise barhana, test karna aur sambhalna asan hai.

blocks.text: Fauri khulasa

items: Class: naqsha (attributes aur methods); object: apni qeematon wala instance; __init__ unhein set karta.
Encapsulation: data aur methods aik class mein; public name, protected _name, private __name.
Inheritance: single, multiple, multilevel; overriding aur super().
Polymorphism: compile-time (overloading, Python mein naqal) aur runtime (overriding).
